1.text: Hariho umuntu wari urwaye witwaga Lazaro w'i Betaniya, ikirorero cy'iwabo wa Mariya na Marita mwene se.

2.text: Mariya uwo ni we wasize Umwami Yesu amavuta ku birenge akabihanaguza umusatsi we, musaza w'uwo ni Lazaro wa wundi wari urwaye.

3.text: Nuko bashiki be batuma kuri Yesu bati “Databuja, uwo ukunda ararwaye.”

4.text: Yesu abyumvise aravuga ati “Iyo ndwara si iyo kumwica, ahubwo ni iyo guhimbarisha Imana no gutuma Umwana w'Imana ahimbazwa.”

5.text: Yesu yakundaga Marita na mwene se na Lazaro.

6.text: Nuko yumvise ko arwaye asibira kabiri aho yari ari.

7.text: Maze iyo minsi ishize abwira abigishwa be ati “Dusubire i Yudaya.”

8.text: Abigishwa baramubaza bati “Mwigisha, amambere Abayuda bashatse kuhaguterera amabuye none usubiyeyo?”

9.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Mbega umunsi ntugira amasaha cumi n'abiri? Ugenda ku manywa ntasitara kuko haba habona,

10.text: ariko ugenda nijoro arasitara kuko haba hatabona.”

11.text: Avuze atyo aherako arababwira ati “Incuti yacu Lazaro irasinziriye, ariko ngiye kumukangura.”

12.text: Abigishwa baramubwira bati “Databuja, niba asinziriye azakira.”

13.text: Nyamara Yesu yavugaga iby'urupfu rwa Lazaro, ariko bo batekereza yuko avuze gusinzira kw'ibitotsi.

14.text: Yesu ni ko kuberurira ati “Lazaro yarapfuye.

15.text: Nanjye nezerewe ku bwanyu kuko ntari mpari, kugira ngo noneho mwizere. Nimuze tujye aho ari.”

16.text: Toma witwaga Didumo abwira abigishwa bagenzi be ati “Natwe tugende dupfane na we.”

17.text: Yesu agezeyo asanga Lazaro amaze iminsi ine mu gituro.

18.text: I Betaniya hari bugufi bw'i Yerusalemu, nka sitadiyo cumi n'eshanu.

19.text: Nuko Abayuda benshi bari baje kwa Marita na Mariya kubahumuriza, kuko musaza wabo yari yapfuye.

20.text: Marita yumvise ko Yesu aje ajya kumusanganira, ariko Mariya asigara yicaye mu nzu.

21.text: Marita abwira Yesu ati “Databuja, iyaba wari hano musaza wanjye ntaba yarapfuye.

22.text: Kandi n'ubu nzi yuko ibyo usabye Imana byose, Imana izabiguha.”

24.text: Marita aramubwira ati “Nzi yuko azazuka mu muzuko wo ku munsi w'imperuka.”

25.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Ni jye kuzuka n'ubugingo, unyizera naho yaba yarapfuye azabaho,

26.text: kandi umuntu wese ukiriho unyizera ntazapfa iteka ryose. Mbese wizeye ibyo?” s

27.text: Aramusubiza ati “Yee, Databuja, nizeye yuko uri Kristo Umwana w'Imana ukwiriye kuza mu isi.”

28.text: Amaze kuvuga ibyo aragenda, ahamagara mwene se Mariya rwihishwa aramubwira ati “Umwigisha yaje araguhamagara.”

30.text: Icyakora Yesu yari atarasohora mu kirorero, ahubwo yari akiri aho Marita yamusanze.

31.text: Abayuda bari bari kumwe na Mariya mu nzu bamuhoza, babonye uburyo ahagurutse vuba asohoka baramukurikira, batekereza ko agiye mu gituro kuririrayo.

32.text: Mariya ageze aho Yesu ari, amubonye yikubita imbere y'ibirenge bye aramubwira ati “Databuja, iyaba wari hano musaza wanjye ntaba yarapfuye.”

33.text: Yesu amubonye arira, n'Abayuda bazanye na bo barira, asuhuza umutima arawuhagarika,

34.text: arababaza ati “Mbese mwamushyize he?”Baramusubiza bati “Databuja, ngwino urebe.”

36.text: Abayuda baravuga bati “Dore ye, nimurebe uburyo yamukundaga!”

37.text: Ariko bamwe muri bo baravuga bati “Uyu ko ahumura impumyi, ntaba yarabashije kubuza n'uyu ntapfe?”

38.text: Yesu yongera gusuhuza umutima, agera ku gituro. Cyari isenga ishyizweho igitare ku munwa.

39.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Nimukureho igitare.”Marita mushiki w'uwapfuye aramubwira ati “Databuja, none aranuka kuko amaze iminsi ine.”

40.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Sinakubwiye nti ‘Niwizera uri bubone ubwiza bw'Imana’?”

41.text: Nuko bakuraho igitare. Yesu arararama aravuga ati “Data, ndagushimye kuko unyumvise.

42.text: Ubwanjye nari nzi yuko unyumva iteka, ariko mbivugiye ku bw'abantu bangose, ngo bizere yuko ari wowe wantumye.”

43.text: Amaze kuvuga ibyo arangurura ijwi rirenga ati “Lazaro, sohoka.”

44.text: Uwari upfuye arasohoka azingazingiwe mu myenda amaguru n'amaboko, n'igitambaro gipfutse mu maso he. Yesu arababwira ati “Nimumuhambure mumureke agende.”

45.text: Nuko benshi mu Bayuda bari baje kwa Mariya babonye icyo akoze baramwizera,

46.text: ariko abandi muri bo bajya ku Bafarisayo, bababwira ibyo Yesu yakoze.

47.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'Abafarisayo bateranya urukiko, barabazanya bati “Tugire dute ko uwo muntu akora ibimenyetso byinshi?

48.text: Nitumurekera dutya bose bazamwizera, kandi Abaroma bazaza barimbure umurwa wacu n'ubwoko bwacu.”

49.text: Ariko umwe muri bo witwaga Kayafa, kandi wari umutambyi mukuru muri uwo mwaka arababwira ati “Nta cyo muzi.

50.text: Mbese ntimutekereza yuko ari byiza ku bwacu, ko umuntu umwe yapfira abantu kuruta ko ubwoko bwose bwarimbuka?”

51.text: Ibyo ntiyabivuze ku bwe, ahubwo kuko yari umutambyi mukuru muri uwo mwaka, yahanuye yuko Yesu yenda gupfira ubwo bwoko,

52.text: ariko si ubwo bwoko bwonyine, ahubwo ni ukugira ngo abana b'Imana batatanye abateranirize hamwe.

53.text: Bahera uwo munsi bajya inama zo kumwica.

54.text: Nuko Yesu ntiyaba akigenda mu Bayuda ku mugaragaro, ahubwo avayo ajya mu gihugu kiri bugufi bw'ubutayu mu mudugudu witwa Efurayimu, agumanayo n'abigishwa be.

55.text: Kuko Pasika y'Abayuda yendaga gusohora, benshi bava mu gihugu barazamuka bajya i Yerusalemu, Pasika itarasohora ngo biyeze.

56.text: Bashaka Yesu, babazanya bahagaze mu rusengero bati “Mbese mutekereza mute? Ntazaza hano mu minsi mikuru?”

57.text: Ariko abatambyi bakuru n'Abafarisayo bari bategetse yuko umuntu namenya aho ari, abibamenyesha bakamufata.
